Walk in Interview
Candidates are invited to walk-in-interview for the appointment of ‘Project Research Scientist-I
(Non-Medical)’-01 in ICMR funded project title ‘Tele-Health Screening and Management for
Non-Communicable Diseases’ coterminous with project depending upon the satisfactory
performance of the candidate at University Institute of Engineering and Technology (UIET),
Sector-25, Panjab University, Chandigarh. Project tenure may go upto February 28, 2027.

Responsibilities:
 Project may involve frequent field travel to different states of India for project implementation.
 Focused working and high quality outcome is expected from the selected candidates.
 Documentation tracking and record maintenance.
 Coordinating with state/ district health authorities for implementation etc.
 Inspecting authoritative publications to discern understudied topics.
 Drafting and proposing project ideas.
 Co-steering joint research undertakings.
 Spearheading data collection and concomitant interpretation.
 Promoting beneficence and minimizing risks.
 Conducting in-house/ outside presentations.
 Securing sufficient pertinent funding to supplement extant finances.
 Any other work assigned by PI/Co-PIs
Reporting Date and Time: November 30, 2026 at 10:00 AM
Reporting Venue: Room# 204, Academic Block#1, UIET, Panjab University, Sector 25,
Chandigarh
The incumbent is expected to work on Saturdays/Sundays and maybe on holidays also for any
project exigency. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates for attending the interview. All
interested candidates may appear along with his/ her biodata and certificates for Walk-In-Interview
as per the Reporting time and Venue mentioned above. The candidates must ascertain their
eligibility before appearing for position, as ineligible candidates will not be interviewed.
Dr. Harish Kumar
Principal Investigator and Professor, CSE UIET,
Panjab University, Chandigarh
